description: This file defines a React hook `useProgressiveExpand` and a utility function `createProgressiveExpandController` for performing batch processing in a non-blocking, progressive manner. It is used to process large sets of items in chunks, yielding control back to the main thread to keep the UI responsive. The hook encapsulates the controller, manages React state for progress, and handles automatic cleanup. This file is specific to the 'hooks' part of a React front-end project.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages progressive batch processing of items, scheduling work via requestIdleCallback or setTimeout, with support for progress callbacks, cancellation, and adaptive batch sizing.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A custom React hook that manages the lifecycle, state, and cleanup of the progressive batch processing using the controller. It exposes controls and progress indicators for UI components.
